title: Mass LinkedIn Company Scraper | Bulk URLs
description: Add company URLs directly, paste CSV, or upload a CSV file.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url or companyUrl column. One company URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url, linkedinUrl, or companyUrl column.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many company URLs to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse the same ID after a stopped run to skip company URLs that already completed. Lists over 20 continue even without an ID.

freshStart.title: Look up finished companies again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
